title: Lockpicking & Survival Tweaks
description: Adds custom loot tables, new advancements, and lockpick crafting recipes designed for the Locks mod.
body:
## Overview
This datapack improves your survival experience by integration with the **Locks** mod, adding immersive thief mechanics and better rewards.

## Features
*   **Lockpicking Crafting:** Craft lockpicks using custom recipes.
*   **Custom Loot Tables:** Find better and more interesting loot in chests.
*   **New Advancements:** Unlock custom advancements as you progress.

## Requirements
* This datapack requires the **Locks** mod and its dependencies (**Loot'n'Explore**, **Tead**, **GeckoLib**) to function properly.
